independence.run_day_freshness: Independent of review training; Smith previously evaluated ELM-O.

protocol.input_recipe: Identical FS02-FS04/DENV2F-3F preprocessing; no BES for our models.
protocol.occupancy: Deduplicated union of 1ms cells wholly inside at least one individual Smith window; any hand region overlap is positive. Cells covered only by stitching across neighboring window edges are excluded conservatively. Not the review's 50ms crowd occupancy target.
protocol.event_truth: Hand-labelled region start, not D-alpha maximum.
protocol.event_matching: Maximum-cardinality one-to-one chronological matching at +/-2 and +/-5 ms; ties minimize absolute timing error; predictions counted only in known Smith time.
protocol.frozen_ensemble: Original cv2 five checkpoints: mean probability / each existing fold threshold, call >=1. No fitting, selection, threshold adjustment or Smith-informed changes. Auxiliary onset head normalized by its frozen fold thresholds likewise.
protocol.bootstrap: 1000 physical-shot resamples, seed 20261003; identical draws across methods; valid/undefined counts recorded; <5 positive-bearing shots descriptive.
protocol.onset_recipe: Same U-Net from scratch, onset-only masked BCE on Smith hand starts; sigma=1 ms; 5 shot folds, 21 inner-validation shots; select trailing-3 mean inner-val event F1 at +/-2ms after warmup; threshold on inner validation only. No review/cohort test shots; no tuning on outer folds.
protocol.limitations: Smith windows are selected around known ELMs, not a continuous-discharge negative population. Event FPs within them depend on completeness of single-region hand annotations. Smith CV is developmental, frozen review-to-Smith transfer is independent.

filterscopes.rule: first monotone acquisition in original source order; independent of labels

interferometer.rule: first monotone acquisition in original source order; independent of labels

protocol.onset_postprocessing: Local maxima at 1 ms output resolution, minimum separation 10 ms, scored in whole Smith-window cells; thresholds frozen for elm-ours and chosen only on inner validation for elm-ours-onset.

coverage_audit.definition: Every 1ms input cell touching the complete Smith window has both FS and interferometer samples; fully covered comparisons use the same windows and all methods. Nine edge onsets can lack a whole scored-window cell, but every truth remains in event denominators and may match an adjacent supported peak within tolerance.

common_covered_comparison.note: After the independently audited source repair, every window is input covered, so common-covered and all-window results coincide; the record stores one copy.

occupancy_1ms.interval_policy: No population-level 95% CI when fewer than five physical shots carry positives; otherwise percentile intervals over finite shot-bootstrap draws, with valid/undefined counts reported.

elm-ours.events_source: Frozen auxiliary onset head; separate from delivered occupancy output, no Smith threshold tuning.
